exact_missing_items: Identity actor envelope now has a minimal agreed shape: project_id + actor_kind + sparse actor refs + requested/effective identity block

The canonical actor envelope must be anchored in Contracts_V0.md and referenced by name from storage-plan.md, usage-feature.md, Provider_Stream_Mapping_External_Reference_A2A.md, and all runtime record schemas
A canonical internal route payload schema must be defined in one doc (Contracts_V0.md or FinalGUISpec.md)
Minimum required fields for all route payloads: surface_id, object_kind, object_id (or object_ref), project_id?
Optional fields depending on surface: run_id, attempt_id, node_id, concern_id, attention_item_id, focus_sub_tab, lane_id, worktree_id
route payload is used by: deep links, palette actions, cmd.*.open_in_* commands, attention item primary_route_payload, and resume_url serialization
Projection closure for route payloads: every primary_route_payload on an attention item and every resume_url must be derivable from the canonical route payload schema
Any surface that accepts a route payload as input (deep-link, cmd.*.open_in_*, palette action, attention item navigation) must validate it against the canonical schema
Stale or malformed route payloads must surface a clear user-facing error, not silently navigate to the wrong surface
Reconciliation-readiness criteria must be specified: when is a project/run state ready for reconciliation after an account switch or degradation event?
